overnightPermit.what: Mount Rainier National Park wilderness camping permit
overnightPermit.where: Reserve online via Recreation.gov, or get a walk-up permit in person at a park Wilderness Information Center; required year-round for any overnight stay, including cross-country-zone camping below Unicorn Peak or The Castle.

overnightPermit.what: Free self-issue Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit
overnightPermit.where: Fill one out at the trailhead kiosk. This is distinct from the quota Enchantment Permit Area to the west.

overnightPermit.what: North Cascades National Park wilderness permit — quota reservation or walk-up
overnightPermit.where: Reserve a night-by-night itinerary online via Recreation.gov during the early-access lottery, or get a walk-up permit in person (about 40% of sites) at the Wilderness Information Center in Marblemount up to 24 hours ahead.
Free, no-reservation camping at Tiffany Springs Campground and along the approach; a Northwest Forest Pass covers trailhead parking.
A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park at the trailhead; camp on snow, rock or bare ground at the designated tarns/sites and pack out human waste.

add.notes: High camp on the col between the Colonial and Neve glaciers, reached via the climbers' path above Pyramid Lake; the same approach and camp Snowfield's standard Neve Glacier route uses, since the West Ridge is its summit finish.

add.name: Colonial Basin
add.permit: North Cascades National Park wilderness permit — reserve via Recreation.gov or walk-up at the Marblemount Wilderness Information Center
add.notes: Basin below Colonial and Pyramid peaks, reached first on the climbers' path above Pyramid Lake before continuing up to the Colonial-Neve col.

routes.note: The West Ridge is described as the standard Neve Glacier route's own summit finish, approached from Pyramid Lake — not the Thunder Creek corridor camps listed for this route, which belong to Booker/Logan's approach instead.

Colonial Glacier moraine camp's note describes bypassing Pyramid Peak's summit on the way to the glacier — likely an alternate ridge line into the same basin rather than a separate objective; kept as an on-route option.

misassigned: wa_fortune_peak_east_slope: its camp list belongs to the Esmeralda Basin/Lake Ann side of the valley, not the Headlight Basin/Ingalls Pass line this route actually climbs — added the correct main camp.

wa_booker_mountain_south_ridge: its camp list is the Thunder Creek/Park Creek corridor (used by Booker's NE Face/NW Route and Mount Logan), but the standard South Ridge approaches via Cascade Pass/Sahale Arm/Horseshoe Basin instead — added Sahale Camp.

wa_mount_logan_r1 (Banded Glacier): most of its listed camps sit past the Fisher Creek Trail fork on the main Thunder Creek Trail and are not reached on this route — added the actual Fisher Creek lake camp below the Banded Glacier.

wa_mount_logan_r2 (Douglas Glacier): approaches from the Easy Pass Trailhead into Fisher Basin, an entirely different trailhead/drainage from the Thunder Creek corridor camps listed — added the Fisher Basin campsites.

wa_neve_glacier_west_ridge (Snowfield Peak): its camp list is the Thunder Creek corridor (Booker/Logan's approach via Colonial Creek Campground), but this route actually approaches via the Pyramid Lake Trailhead like the rest of Snowfield's routes — added Colonial-Neve col and Colonial Basin.

wa_the_needle_neve_glacier: most of its listed camps are the Thunder Creek corridor and are not on its Pyramid Lake approach; its own 'Colonial Glacier moraine-lake camp' entry is the correct one and was kept as main.
wa_storm_king_north_face: its camp list is mostly the west-side Colonial Creek corridor, but this route is approached from the east via High Bridge/Park Creek, matching only Five Mile Camp.
